mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LA_ROLES (authority,alias,icon,remarks,createDate,tenantId,owner,roletype, datatype, enabled, group_id) VALUES( #{authority}, #{alias}, #{icon,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remarks,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDate}, #{tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{owner,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{roleType,jdbcType=INTEGER},#{dataType,jdbcType=INTEGER},1, #{groupId})
mapper.select: SELECT authority, alias, roleType, datatype, enabled, icon, remarks, createDate, CASE WHEN group_id IS NULL THEN 'default' ELSE group_id END group_id FROM LA_ROLES WHERE authority = #{authority}
mapper.update: UPDATE LA_ROLES SET alias = #{alias,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, remarks = #{remarks,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, roletype = #{roleType,jdbcType=INTEGER}, datatype = #{dataType,jdbcType=INTEGER}, enabled = #{enabled,jdbcType=INTEGER}, GROUP_ID = #{groupId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE authority = #{authority}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LA_ROLES T WHERE T.authority = #{authority})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM LA_ROLE_RESOURCES WHERE authority = #{authority} AND resourceid = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LA_ROLE_RESOURCES (resourceid, authority, tenantId, la_manage) VALUES (#{id},#{authority}, #{tenantId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.update: UPDATE LA_ROLE_RESOURCES SET la_manage = #{status, jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE authority = #{authority} AND resourceid IN #{item}
mapper.select: SELECT resourceid FROM LA_ROLE_RESOURCES WHERE authority = #{authority}
